bagPolicy.summary: The stadium guide permits clear bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches; medical bags receive additional inspection at Gates 6 and 10. The university’s published clear-bag rule covers sporting events, so confirm requirements for a concert.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
